messages.subject: IRPC | Industrial transformation, sustainability and stakeholder strategy
messages.body:
Dear IRPC Executive Leadership Team,

IRPC's focus on sustainable industrial development and environmental stewardship aligns closely with the work I lead across ESG, stakeholder relations and regulated operations.

I serve as Liaison Director, Social Responsibility Department at AGM Inc., part of Zijin Mining Group. My mandate spans government and regulatory relations, corporate coordination, social performance, ESG and executive stakeholder strategy across a major industrial site.

I bring practical experience supporting a large renewable-energy and battery-storage transition, carbon-data readiness and multi-agency regulatory coordination. I also manage community-sensitive and reputation-sensitive matters that require clear ownership across operations, environment, HSE, legal, finance, HR and technical teams.

I would welcome consideration for Thailand or regional roles in Corporate Affairs, Sustainability, Government Relations, Strategic Partnerships or executive stakeholder leadership. I have attached an IRPC-focused executive CV for review.

Kind regards,
Ragunauth Ramsaroop
